description: An area on the earth's surface, independent of time or any building or other material that might be located there.

Name.description: Link to the reified Name collection.

Identifier.description: Link to the reified Identifier collection.

Equivalent.description: This field is used to document a URI which is meant to indicate an equivalence between the documented place and a resolvable, structured reference resource that stands as a document for this self same entity.

Type.description: Link to the reified Type collection.

Coordinates.description: This field is used to record coordinate data which defines the geospatial location of the documented place.

Part of Location.description: This field is used to record the broader place to which the documented place belongs as part.

Statement.description: Link to the reified Statement collection.

Depicting Image.description: This field  is used to record the existence of an image which depicts the documented place.

Digital Reference.description: Link to the reified Digital Reference collection.

Source Reference Work.description: This field is used to link the documented place to an instance of textual work which references it.
